mechanism: Diphenhydramine has anticholinergic and sedating properties that potentiate CNS depression with phenelzine (MAOI), and may potentiate hypertensive crisis risk if diphenhydramine contains sympathomimetic impurities or if used with certain formulations.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, use lowest effective doses with close monitoring for excessive sedation, CNS depression, and blood pressure changes.
